description: Update the core on All-Inkl over FTPS.
dry_run: Check and list the local payload without connecting (default).
apply: Connect and update the existing installation.
preview: Preview only. Use --apply to update the server.
password_terminal: Use an interactive terminal or set WEEWX_DEPLOY_PASSWORD.
invalid_password: A valid FTP password is required.

remote_path: Remote path is not a regular file or directory: {detail}

wrong_root: The remote root must contain an existing core installation.
locked: Deployment is locked or the lock cannot be created.
unchanged: Core is already up to date.
restored: Update failed. Previous files restored. Backup: {detail}

error: Deployment failed. Check the configuration, connection and file permissions.
